meta.scope: Saudi Arabia Batch 1 — Phase 0/1 foundations under locked expanded node definition. General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT), population, national accounts, CPI, Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) institutional core, BOP. Population ~35 million. Oil + Vision 2030 diversification structure.

candidates.title: General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) institutional core
candidates.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, labour, demographic and multi-domain socio-economic statistics.
candidates.notes: Foundational institutional node for the Saudi statistical system.

candidates.title: Population census and estimates
candidates.description: Official population census and estimates. Population is approximately 35 million; the structure includes a large non-Saudi workforce and rapid urbanisation under Vision 2030 projects.

candidates.title: National Accounts of Saudi Arabia (GDP)
candidates.description: Official national accounts (GDP). The economy remains oil-dominated but non-oil activity has expanded under Vision 2030; real growth has been positive in recent periods with diversification progress tracked closely.
candidates.notes: Primary macroeconomic output node. Oil still dominant; non-oil share rising.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
candidates.description: CPI and inflation rates. Inflation has been moderate in recent periods under the riyal peg and active demand management.

candidates.title: Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) institutional and reporting core
candidates.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, the riyal peg, foreign-exchange reserves management and key macro-financial and external statistics. Publishes monetary, banking, exchange-rate, BOP and related series.
candidates.notes: Central-bank institutional counterpart to GASTAT. Riyal peg is the monetary anchor.

candidates.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
candidates.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Oil exports dominate the current account; large net foreign assets and reserves are structural features of the external position.
candidates.notes: External-accounts node under oil-export dominance and large reserve buffers.

candidates.title: Saudi Arabia foundational statistical-system meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from GASTAT and SAMA sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding the GASTAT institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, SAMA institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Saudi research.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
candidates.notes: Opening integrating node. Oil + Vision 2030 diversification will structure subsequent densification.
